name: Dragon Awaken
author: Addicting Games
description: Dragon Awaken is a strategic dungeon dive set in a fantasy world! In this dangerous fantasy reality, you are warrior destined to do great things. Following the orders of your commander, you attack a dragon lair with your comrades but something goes wrong. You end up possessing the power of the dragon and becoming one of the legendary dragon knights! Now, you will have to find the meaning of your newfound powers. But it won't be easy. Like in all mmogames you'll have to start small and grind your way up to the top of the food chain. Life in the dragon age is hard can you take it?
